title: Lox meat pie
content:
# Lox meat pie

Type: Food | Internal ID: LoxPie | Source: Stone oven | Usage: Crafting, Eating | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Unbaked lox pie x1 | Max Health: 75 | Max Stamina: 24 | Duration: 30m | Healing: 4 hp/tick

# Introduction

Lox meat pie is a Plains-tier food.

## Recipe

Unbaked lox pie is produced in a Food preparation table with:
• 2 Cloudberries
• 2 Lox meat
• 4 Barley flour
Lox meat pie is produced by cooking Unbaked lox pie in a Stone oven for 50 seconds. If left in the oven for 100 seconds, it will burn and turn into Coal.

### Crafting

• Plains pie picnic

## Notes

• Lox meat pie provides the second-highest health gain in the Plains at 75, second to Serpent stew, which provides 80

Categorias: Food, Materials
